summary: DynoPay brand icon refresh (Bold Loop) rollout verified. Email v3 chip served AND legacy v2 chip still 200 (already-sent emails still resolve). getDynopayLogoUrl() from backend/utils/emailTemplate.ts returns the /api/static/dynopay-email-logo-v3.png URL as expected. Frontend: homepage <head> has every ?v=6 link + og:image ?v=3. Wordmark lockup renders at naturalWidth=134 in home header+footer (dark=whiteLogo, light=blackLogo via data-testid=theme-toggle-button), /auth/login and /auth/register (blackLogo, not broken). /press cards (press-download-black/white/icon) all present and hrefs return 200. Hosted checkout /pay?d=rNtQRX renders <Logo data-testid=dynopay-logo> viewBox 0 0 64 64 as a single white path with fill-rule=evenodd — arrows visibly cut out (screenshot confirms). Public receipt /receipt/oN7U2knyNnaQ3NBrfNXL3F renders the <Logo> without errors after cold-compile retry. Merchant login (onarrival21) reaches dash2026-root; wordmark visible in sidebar in both light and dark in-app modes. No functionality regressions observed. SAFE MODE respected — no mutations.
